phase_origin: lock cascaded decimation phase at startup; expose profile/phase ID
timing_gate: A-port replay read_start = target output reference - measured causal pipeline - reference_index*4 ticks; too-early/late/off-grid reject; Fine/DMA do not gate accepted replay
aux_history_rule: PL42 minimum plus analogsettling and RFDC/history/actual pipeline; keep source sequence during invalid interval
tail_rule: FD63 62-sample flush removed. RXCAL/target/TXCAL/TX FIR/RFDC/analog tails remain and must be remeasured; PL TX minimum42 zero input samples remains.
2ns_note: timestamp granularity only, not clock edge positioning or measured uncertainty
alignment_policy: strict exact: target/reference/fixed latency must map to executable 4-tick core grid; off-grid rejected, never rounded later
